synthesizedFacts.fact: Stretch marks, or striae gravidarum, are common during pregnancy due to rapid skin stretching and hormonal changes.
Maintaining skin hydration and elasticity through diet, hydration, and topical applications can help reduce the severity of stretch marks.
Genetic factors play a role in the likelihood of developing stretch marks during pregnancy.
Topical treatments such as creams containing retinoids, hyaluronic acid, or glycolic acid may improve the appearance of stretch marks, but should be used with caution during pregnancy.
